columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Delegated subagents must remain inside the root goal's resource budget
columns.title_zh: 委派子 Agent 必须受根目标资源预算约束
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260828-019 with Skill 02 score 46/50. Child and nested subagent token use is rolled into the active root goal during active and idle accounting, so delegation cannot escape the parent goal's resource budget. This creates a bounded, testable digital-work governance question about whether delegated workers inherit the resource constraints of the goal that authorized them.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260828-019，Skill 02 评分 46/50。Child 与 Nested Subagent 的 Token 使用会在 Active 与 Idle Accounting 中汇总到当前 Root Goal，使委派无法绕开父目标的资源预算。该机制形成了一个边界清晰、可测试的数字工作治理问题：被委派 Worker 是否必须继承授权它的目标所承担的资源约束。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify how descendant usage is attributed across active and idle accounting, which descendants are included, where the root budget is enforced, what happens at budget exhaustion or cancellation, and which tests prove nested delegation cannot escape accounting. Keep conclusions bounded to the demonstrated Codex goal/subagent contract.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验后代用量如何在 Active/Idle Accounting 中归集、哪些后代被计入、Root Budget 在何处执行、预算耗尽或取消时如何处理，以及哪些测试证明 Nested Delegation 无法逃逸计量；结论须限定于已展示的 Codex Goal/Subagent 合同。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Managed policy refresh must fail closed rather than reuse stale authority
columns.title_zh: 受管策略刷新失败时必须 Fail Closed，而不能继续使用陈旧权限
columns.source_zh: GitHub Copilot CLI 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260828-025 with Skill 02 score 46/50. When forced remote policy refresh is enabled, cached managed policy is no longer accepted after fetch failure; the session enters a restrictive undetermined-policy posture until fresh authority is obtained. This exposes a precise enterprise architecture boundary between policy availability, policy freshness and execution authority.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260828-025，Skill 02 评分 46/50。启用强制远端策略刷新后，Fetch Failure 时不再接受缓存的 Managed Policy，而是在获得新鲜权威策略前进入受限的 Undetermined-policy Posture。该机制清晰暴露企业架构中的一条边界：策略可用性、策略新鲜度与执行授权不能混为一谈。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the exact force-refresh trigger, which cached state is rejected, the capabilities allowed in the undetermined-policy posture, transition behavior after fresh policy arrives, and failure-path tests. Do not generalize this implementation into proof that all enterprise policy systems require identical fallback semantics.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Force Refresh 的精确触发条件、哪些缓存状态会被拒绝、Undetermined-policy Posture 允许哪些能力、新策略到达后的状态迁移，以及失败路径测试；不得把该实现泛化为所有企业策略系统都必须采用相同回退语义。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Cached approval evidence must be rebound to current authorization state
columns.title_zh: 缓存审批证据必须重新绑定当前授权状态
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260828-017 with Skill 02 score 46/50. Cached Guardian classifications are tied to current local and root authorization state so a stale risk decision cannot keep authorizing an action after governing authority changes. The mechanism is a concrete engineering pattern for preventing cached decision evidence from outliving the authorization context that made it valid.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260828-017，Skill 02 评分 46/50。缓存的 Guardian Classification 绑定当前 Local 与 Root Authorization State，避免 Governing Authority 变化后旧 Risk Decision 继续授权动作。该机制提供了一条具体工程模式：缓存的决策证据不能活得比使它有效的授权上下文更久。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify which authorization identities participate in cache validity, how local/root authority changes invalidate or partition cached classifications, where reused approval evidence is consumed, and the negative tests proving stale decisions cannot authorize after an authority change. Keep conclusions bounded to the demonstrated Guardian cache contract.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验哪些授权身份参与 Cache Validity、Local/Root Authority 变化如何使缓存 Classification 失效或分区、复用审批证据在哪里被消费，以及哪些负向测试证明 Authority Change 后陈旧决策不能继续授权；结论须限定于已展示的 Guardian Cache 合同。
